title: Lean formalization
headline: Three laws machine-checked in Lean 4 (zero sorry, standard axioms); 6 of 6 deliberately broken statements rejected by the compiler; blind OpenAI gpt-5-2025-08-07 assessor: 3 faithful-with-narrower-scope, 1 faithful, 0 unfaithful; 13 unsigned nanopub drafts, all 13 pass a scripted TriG parse + np check (text-parsed, exit code not trusted), lint clean, no template declared, no human named, nothing signed or published.
